invalidCharacters: This contains characters that are not allowed.
mustAcceptTerms: You must accept the Terms of Service.
mustAcceptPrivacy: You must accept the Privacy Policy.
duplicate: Each item can be chosen only once.
primaryClient: The primary client must be one of the selected clients.
amount: Enter an amount with at most two decimals.
sort: This sort order is not supported.
unknownClient: One of the selected clients does not exist or is inactive.
responsibleLawyer: Choose an active lawyer from your office.
responsibleParalegal: Choose an active paralegal from your office.
primaryLawyer: Choose an active lawyer from your office.
primaryContact: To change the primary contact, make another contact primary.

password.weak: Use upper- and lower-case letters and at least one digit.
password.common: This password is too common. Choose another one.
password.sameAsEmail: The password must not be your email address.
password.unchanged: Choose a password different from the current one.

assignee: Choose an active colleague who can work on this case.
taskColumn: All the tasks must be in the chosen column.
unknownCourt: The selected court does not exist.
unknownJudge: The selected judge does not exist or does not sit at the selected court.
dateTime: Enter a valid date and time.
endsBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
sessionTooLong: A hearing can last at most 24 hours.
dateRange: Choose an end after the start, at most 92 days later.
reminderDays: Reminders can be 0 to 365 days before the hearing.
attendingLawyer: Choose an active lawyer who can see this case.
sessionConflict: The lawyer has another hearing at this time.
sessionNotHeld: The outcome can be recorded once the hearing has started.
nextSessionExists: The next hearing has already been scheduled.
nextSessionBefore: The next hearing must start after this one.
unknownFolder: The selected folder does not exist in this case.
folderMove: A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its subfolders.
folderDepth: Folders can be nested at most 5 levels deep.
folderLimit: A case can have at most 200 folders.
website: Enter a web address starting with http:// or https://.
reminderRange: Reminders can be 1 to 30 days ahead (0 = the due day, for tasks only).
fileNumberFormat: Use {YEAR}, {TYPE} and exactly one {SEQ} or {SEQ:n} (n from 1 to 9), with letters, digits, spaces and . _ / # - between them.
percent: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 with at most two decimals.
auditRetention: Keep the audit log for at least 365 days and at most 3650.
roleHasOpenFiles: This person is responsible for open files. Reassign them by deactivating the account, or keep a lawyer role.
reassignAllFiles: Choose a new responsible lawyer for every open file.
unknownSession: The selected hearing does not belong to this case.
idempotencyKey: The request key must be 8 to 128 letters, digits, - or _.
partyChoice: Choose an existing party or enter a new one, not both.
unknownParty: This party does not exist in your office.
inviteRole: Choose a role other than office manager.
